properties.name: Najafgarh Nallah
properties.description: The Najafgarh Nallah is a channelized waterway that was once a part of the Sahibi River and an elongation of the Najafgarh Jheel Lake. It flows through rural southwest Delhi and ultimately outfalls into the Yamuna River.
